'''P-5C3''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] present on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
P-5C3 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Binary Star reputation vendor.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' {{1st}}
